title: Find My Saplings
description: This resource pack adds outlines to every sapling item in minecraft, making sure you replant every tree!
body:
# Find My Saplings

 ![Oak sapling with pure black outline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ce3c183a7398d952542647ab4d8ee5044f9508c.png) ![Cherry sapling with pure black outline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4cb359e9ee72f11631a339db59eff31ec3341dda.png) ![Pale Oak sapling with pure black outline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30948047888f71d649d338853eaa9a839b758d94.png)
Remember to plant every sapling that falls on the ground with this resource pack!

![birch sapling with pure black outline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9317e9fa4895e45c494abeee8a4a6a29e8095a0.png) ![jungle sapling with pure black outline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e36d533355953ac816a50f4d4871a1ea63e6eb9.png) ![Dark Oak sapling with pure black outline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc6bc3e0375ddd1b44f86968ab6c6f1df09847cd.png) Adds pure black outlines to every sapling item 

Useful for farming trees for houses and such
